articles.title: IIT Indore Scientists Crack Open AI’s ‘Black Box’, Find Machines Can Learn Laws Of Chaos
articles.description: IIT Indore researchers have found evidence that AI can learn underlying physical laws governing chaotic systems rather than merely memorising past patterns. Led by Prof Sarika Jalan, the study examined how machine learning predicts critical “tipping points” and could eventually aid early warnings for climate shifts, financial crashes and epileptic seizures.

articles.title: FPIs sell $1.6 billion of Indian stocks in five trading sessions
articles.description: After a brief period of optimism, foreign investors are retreating from Indian stocks as rising crude oil prices and escalating global bond yields shift market dynamics. This change reflects a waning interest in emerging market growth assets, compounded by profit-taking strategies and a pivot towards AI investments. While domestic buying could offer some support, ongoing external pressures may dampen overall returns.
